claims: Life's Still Unfair (2026) is the Malcolm in the Middle reboot.
Kelly is the youngest child of Hal and Lois in Life's Still Unfair (2026).
Kelly is played by Vaughan Murrae.
Vaughan Murrae is a nonbinary actor.
Kelly is a self-sufficient, studious teenager.
Kelly maintains a rivalry with Reese.
Kelly stems from the pregnancy reveal in the original Malcolm in the Middle 2006 series finale.
Kelly is "wiser than most of their family."
Kelly is capable of being a trickster.
Kelly often acts as the "good" or favorite child.
Kelly is not above playing tricks to get back at siblings.
Kelly engages in a heated rivalry with Reese.
Kelly was born to Hal and Lois years after the original Malcolm in the Middle series ended.
